en_meaning: Showing a critical or disrespectful attitude towards someone or something
vi_meaning: Mang tính xúc phạm, làm giảm uy tín hoặc coi thường
example_sentence: The editorial drew widespread condemnation for its derogatory characterization of immigrant workers, which critics argued stoked xenophobia rather than contributing to constructive policy debates.

en_meaning: To talk or write at length about a particular subject
vi_meaning: Bàn luận hoặc thuyết giảng chi tiết về một chủ đề
example_sentence: During his evening lectures, the venerable classicist would often descant at length upon the rhetorical subtleties of Cicero's orations.

en_meaning: To catch sight of or discover something distant or obscure
vi_meaning: Nhìn thấy hoặc phát hiện ra từ xa hoặc lờ mờ
example_sentence: Scanning the storm-tossed horizon through his spyglass, the navigator managed to descry the faint, flickering beacon of the coastal lighthouse.

en_meaning: To treat a sacred place or thing with violent disrespect
vi_meaning: Mạo phạm, bôi nhọ hoặc làm ô uế nơi thiêng liêng
example_sentence: Vandals who breached the cathedral compound sought to desecrate the sanctuary by toppling centuries-old marble altars and defacing religious iconography.

en_meaning: To remove the moisture from something; to dry out completely
vi_meaning: Làm khô cạn, rút hết độ ẩm hoặc sấy khô hoàn toàn
example_sentence: Prolonged meteorological drought threatened to desiccate the fertile wetland ecosystem, leaving migratory waterfowl without vital foraging grounds.

en_meaning: Feeling or showing misery, unhappiness, or loneliness; deserted of people
vi_meaning: Hoang vắng, tiêu điều, cô độc tuyệt vọng
example_sentence: Following the abrupt closure of the iron foundry, the boomtown was reduced to a desolate expanse of boarded storefronts and windswept avenues.

en_meaning: To feel contempt or a deep repugnance for someone or something
vi_meaning: Khinh rẻ, coi thường hoặc ghét cay ghét đắng
example_sentence: Though the sycophantic courtiers flattered the monarch to his face, they secretly despised his petty vindictiveness and capricious cruelty.

en_meaning: To steal or remove valuable possessions from a place; to plunder
vi_meaning: Cướp đoạt, tước đoạt hoặc bóc lột của cải
example_sentence: Unregulated strip-mining operations threatened to despoil the pristine river basin, stripping indigenous communities of both their ancestral homeland and ecological sustenance.

en_meaning: In low spirits from loss of hope or courage
vi_meaning: Nản lòng, thoái chí hoặc tuyệt vọng
example_sentence: After successive laboratory explosions ruined months of synthesis trials, the young chemist grew despondent, questioning the fundamental viability of his hypothesis.

en_meaning: A ruler or other person who holds absolute power, typically exercising it cruelly
vi_meaning: Kẻ bạo chúa, người cầm quyền độc tài và tàn bạo
example_sentence: Refusing to tolerate any semblance of dissent, the military despot dismantled the independent judiciary and shuttered opposition printing presses.

en_meaning: Extremely poor and lacking the means to provide for oneself
vi_meaning: Cực kì nghèo khổ, bần cùng, thiếu thốn
example_sentence: The catastrophic deflation of the agrarian economy left thousands of tenant sharecroppers entirely destitute, dependent on meager municipal rations.

en_meaning: Lacking a plan, purpose, or enthusiasm; occurring in an unfocused manner
vi_meaning: Rời rạc, không có hệ thống hoặc mục đích rõ ràng
example_sentence: The congressional hearing produced little actionable insight because the committee engaged in desultory questioning rather than pursuing a cohesive investigative line.

en_meaning: Separate or disconnected; objective and free from emotional involvement
vi_meaning: Khách quan, vô tư, không bị cảm xúc chi phối
example_sentence: A supreme court justice is expected to maintain a detached demeanor, weighing contentious constitutional disputes purely through statutory analysis rather than partisan sentiment.

en_meaning: Firmness of purpose; the process of establishing something exactly
vi_meaning: Sự quyết tâm kiên định hoặc sự xác định chính xác
example_sentence: The paleontologist's relentless determination to excavate the fossilized strata eventually yielded an intact specimen that revolutionized avian evolutionary taxonomy.

en_meaning: Something that discourages or prevents a certain action through fear of consequences
vi_meaning: Vật ngăn chặn, biện pháp răn đe
example_sentence: Geopolitical analysts maintain that a well-enforced regime of multilateral economic sanctions serves as an indispensable deterrent against cross-border aggression.

en_meaning: The action of causing a bomb or explosive device to explode
vi_meaning: Sự phát nổ, sự kích nổ
example_sentence: Seismographic stations across the continent recorded the precise tremor generated by the underground detonation of the experimental ordinance.

en_meaning: The act of disparaging or belittling the reputation or value of someone
vi_meaning: Sự gièm pha, bôi nhọ hoặc làm giảm uy tín
example_sentence: The pioneering astronomer endured years of malicious detraction from entrenched academic peers before orbital photographs indisputably confirmed her stellar models.

en_meaning: Tending to cause harm, damage, or negative effects
vi_meaning: Có hại, gây tổn hại hoặc bất lợi
example_sentence: Agronomists warned that the excessive application of synthetic nitrogen fertilizers exerts detrimental effects on subterranean microbiomes and local aquifer purity.

en_meaning: To depart from an established course or standard
vi_meaning: Chệch hướng, làm khác đi so với lộ trình hoặc tiêu chuẩn
example_sentence: When thermal fluctuations caused the automated spacecraft to deviate slightly from its orbital corridor, onboard guidance thrusters fired immediate correctional pulses.

en_meaning: Showing a skillful use of underhanded tactics to achieve goals
vi_meaning: Láu cá, quỷ quyệt, quanh co không trung thực
example_sentence: The minister utilized devious backroom stratagems and confidential leakages to undermine his cabinet rivals without exposing himself to public scrutiny.

en_meaning: To plan or invent a complex procedure or system by careful thought
vi_meaning: Phát minh, sáng chế, đặt ra kế hoạch
example_sentence: Ecological engineers must devise novel desalination architectures that reduce caloric energy consumption while protecting fragile littoral marine habitats.

en_meaning: Entirely lacking or free from something
vi_meaning: Hoàn toàn không có, trống rỗng
example_sentence: The author's stark prose style was purposefully devoid of sentimental embellishment, lending the harrowing war chronicle an air of unvarnished documentary realism.

en_meaning: A person who is very interested in and enthusiastic about someone or something
vi_meaning: Người say mê cuồng nhiệt, tín đồ trung thành
example_sentence: As an impassioned devotee of Renaissance polyphony, the maestro spent decades scouring monastic archives for forgotten choral manuscripts.

en_meaning: Having or showing deep religious feeling or commitment
vi_meaning: Sùng đạo, thành tâm mộ đạo
example_sentence: The pilgrim community adhered to devout traditions of predawn meditation and communal fasting, seeking spiritual transcendence away from modern distractions.

en_meaning: Showing or having skill, especially with the hands
vi_meaning: Khéo léo, thuần thục, tinh xảo
example_sentence: The watchmaker's dexterous manipulation of microscopic gears and escapements required decades of meticulous manual apprenticeship.

en_meaning: Characteristic of the Devil, or so evil as to be suggestive of the Devil
vi_meaning: Tàn ác như quỷ dữ, thâm hiểm độc ác
example_sentence: The prosecutor unmasked the syndicate's diabolical scheme to adulterate neonatal pharmaceuticals with inert solvents to inflate corporate profit margins.

en_meaning: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination
vi_meaning: Sự chẩn đoán bệnh trạng hoặc căn nguyên vấn đề
example_sentence: Molecular pathology enabled clinicians to render an definitive genetic diagnosis long before clinical symptoms of the neuromuscular disease manifested.

en_meaning: To make someone feel uneasy or embarrassed
vi_meaning: Làm bối rối, làm lúng túng, khiến bồn chồn
example_sentence: The investigative reporter's pointed questions regarding undisclosed offshore accounts visibly discomfited the corporate spokesperson during the press conference.

en_meaning: A state of feeling unsettled, agitated, or lacking self-control
vi_meaning: Sự mất bình tĩnh, sự bối rối hoặc mất tự chủ
example_sentence: Despite his aristocratic poise, the ambassador could not conceal his discomposure when confronted with intercepted cables exposing his covert alliances.

en_meaning: To disturb the composure of; to unsettle or confuse someone
vi_meaning: Làm bối rối, làm lúng túng hoặc làm mất tự nhiên
example_sentence: The sudden and unprovoked resignation of the lead defense attorney threatened to disconcert the entire legal defense team on the eve of the trial.

en_meaning: Deeply unhappy or dejected; unable to be comforted
vi_meaning: U sầu, đau buồn khôn xiết, không thể an ủi
example_sentence: In the wake of the devastating shipwreck, disconsolate families congregated upon the stormy bluffs, staring hopelessly into the unforgiving surf.

en_meaning: Disagreement between people or a lack of harmony between notes
vi_meaning: Sự bất hòa, sự xung đột hoặc âm thanh nghịch tai
example_sentence: Simmering sectarian discord between rival factions paralyzed the transitional government and stalled constitutional negotiations.

en_meaning: Disagreeing or incongruous; harsh and jarring in sound
vi_meaning: Bất hòa, trái ngược hoặc chói tai, không hòa hợp
example_sentence: The speaker's inflammatory rhetoric introduced a discordant element into what had otherwise been a harmonious diplomatic symposium.

en_meaning: To disregard as unimportant or to reduce the price of something
vi_meaning: Xem nhẹ, không coi trọng hoặc chiết khấu, giảm giá
example_sentence: Climatologists warned national policymakers not to discount subtle shifts in ocean currents, which could trigger catastrophic regional weather disruptions.

en_meaning: Written or spoken communication or debate on a particular subject
vi_meaning: Bài diễn thuyết, đàm thoại hoặc diễn ngôn học thuật
example_sentence: Enlightenment philosophers maintained that civil discourse governed by rational inquiry is the indispensable bedrock of a thriving democratic republic.

en_meaning: To harm the good reputation of someone or to cause disbelief
vi_meaning: Làm mất uy tín, làm giảm độ tin cậy hoặc bác bỏ
example_sentence: Subsequent laboratory replications failed to substantiate the controversial findings, effectively discrediting the physicist's revolutionary claims.

en_meaning: A lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
vi_meaning: Sự khác biệt, sự không nhất quán giữa các con số hoặc dữ kiện
example_sentence: Forensic auditors identified a glaring discrepancy between the corporate ledger and the taxable revenue declared to the federal treasury.

en_meaning: Individually separate and distinct from others
vi_meaning: Riêng biệt, rời rạc, độc lập với nhau
example_sentence: Cognitive neuroscientists demonstrated that episodic memory and motor procedural skill are mediated by discrete neural circuits within the cerebral cortex.

en_meaning: The freedom to decide what should be done in a particular situation
vi_meaning: Quyền tự do quyết định hoặc sự thận trọng kín đáo
example_sentence: The statutory statute confers broad administrative discretion upon the environmental commissioner to adjust emission caps during ecological emergencies.

en_meaning: Having or showing refined taste or good judgment
vi_meaning: Có óc phán đoán tốt, biết phân biệt tinh tế
example_sentence: The gallery curator possessed a discriminating eye for composition, instantly distinguishing authentic Renaissance canvasses from late romantic imitations.

en_meaning: Moving from topic to topic without order; rambling
vi_meaning: Lan man, không tập trung, dông dài
example_sentence: Though packed with erudite allusions, the author's discursive treatise wandered aimlessly across disparate theological debates without ever answering its core thesis.

en_meaning: The feeling that someone or something is unworthy of respect
vi_meaning: Sự khinh miệt, thái độ coi thường
example_sentence: The patrician aristocracy viewed the rising merchant class with open disdain, scoffing at their commercial fortunes as vulgar and unrefined.

en_meaning: To leave a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle
vi_meaning: Xuống tàu, máy bay hoặc các phương tiện vận tải
example_sentence: Upon anchoring in the sheltered harbor, the weary expeditionary crew prepared to disembark and establish an inland encampment.

en_meaning: To deprive someone of a right or privilege, especially the right to vote
vi_meaning: Tước quyền công dân, đặc biệt là quyền bầu cử
example_sentence: Arbitrary residency requirements and restrictive voter identification laws were historically leveraged to disenfranchise vulnerable minority populations.

en_meaning: To separate or release from something that it is attached to
vi_meaning: Tháo rời, tách ra hoặc rút lui
example_sentence: Recognizing that the regional insurgency was drawing imperial forces into an unwinnable quagmire, the field commander chose to disengage his battalions and fortify the frontier.

en_meaning: To spoil the appearance or shape of something
vi_meaning: Làm biến dạng, làm mất đi vẻ thẩm mỹ vốn có
example_sentence: Centuries of industrial air pollution and atmospheric acid deposition have begun to corrode and disfigure the intricate limestone relief sculptures of the cathedral facade.

en_meaning: To discharge or pour out contents from the mouth or an opening
vi_meaning: Nôn ra, tuôn ra hoặc xả ra lượng lớn
example_sentence: When the subterranean lava tube finally fractured under tectonic pressure, the volcanic caldera began to disgorge colossal torrents of basaltic magma.

en_meaning: To make someone dissatisfied, moody, or resentful
vi_meaning: Làm cho bực bội, bất mãn hoặc cau có
example_sentence: The administration's arbitrary suspension of customary health benefits did much to disgruntle the factory workforce and trigger wildcat walkouts.

en_meaning: To cause someone to lose determination or confidence
vi_meaning: Làm nản lòng, làm mất đi niềm tin và nhuệ khí
example_sentence: The persistent denial of federal grant renewals threatened to dishearten the young epidemiological researchers studying antimicrobial resistance.

en_meaning: Untidy or disordered in appearance, especially hair or clothing
vi_meaning: Luộm thuộm, xộc xệch, rối bời (đầu tóc, quần áo)
example_sentence: Emerging from weeks of solitary confinement in the damp dungeon, the prisoner stood before the magistrates with gaunt cheeks and disheveled garments.
